title: FMTECH - Career Opportunities, KSA
description: Official JLL-posted FMTECH hiring page for multiple on-site Saudi facilities-management roles across Riyadh, Jeddah, and Khobar. The posting explicitly lists operations-heavy openings including Operations Manager, Site Manager, Fleet Site Manager, HSE Specialist, Housekeeping Specialist, Document Controller, and several engineering roles, making it a strong employer-controlled opportunity pool for operations, site, facilities, and HSE pathways rather than a single narrow vacancy.
